meta.question: on CUB (final, seeds 1-3, K=29), do images whose MaskedKD kept set changes more from e25 to final lose more masked-teacher signal?
meta.method: per image Jaccard of the top-29 kept sets at e25 and final snapshots and change of KL(full teacher || teacher on the kept patches); seed-mean per image; Spearman and partial Spearman with image bootstrap
